stage: Targeted normal correction after read-only source and real context inspection
cause: All152side polygons of a continuously sampled Catmull outline remain flat shaded; WeightedNormal does not enable their smoothing.
method: Keep the two broad caps flat and cap-to-side boundaries sharp. Give only the continuous side outline a smooth custom normal field derived from its adjacent side tangents before the existing bevel. Preserve bevel geometry/width/segments; enable hardened field transport and remove the redundant WeightedNormal on this object only.
protected: All source/evaluated positions, topology, UV, material and transforms on the cover; all evaluated geometry/normals/UV/matrices/materials of every other node; dial artwork, USB, glass normal splits, angles/pivots/controls.
rejection: Reject if evaluated triangle positions or volume move, any cap becomes crowned, other node buffers change or actual macro still shows segment bands.
previews: Same protocol whole rear and cover detail; actual8sample previews read before96. Source/export hash check and no near clipping. No physical shape recalibration or currentRDC measurement inferred.
